question: The process used for removing gangue from the ore works on the basis of difference of their chemical or physical properties and is called ______ of ores.
solution:
The correct answer is __**enrichment**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Enrichment** is the process used to remove gangue (impurities) from ores by utilizing differences in their **chemical or physical properties**.
 
• This technique ensures that the ore is concentrated, increasing the proportion of valuable minerals and reducing impurities.
 
• Common methods used for enrichment include **gravity separation**, **froth flotation**, **magnetic separation**, and **chemical leaching**.
 
• The choice of enrichment method depends on the physical and chemical characteristics of the ore and gangue materials.
 
• Enrichment helps in minimizing wastage during the extraction process and enhances the efficiency of subsequent steps like smelting and refining.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Gravity Separation:**

 
 
• This method utilizes the difference in density between the ore and gangue particles.
 
• It involves techniques like jigging, shaking tables, or using hydraulic classifiers.
 
• Example: Concentration of hematite ore (Fe₂O₃).
 
 
 
• **Froth Flotation:**
 
 
• Used for sulfide ores, this method separates hydrophobic materials from hydrophilic ones using a frothing agent.
 
• Example: Concentration of copper ore (CuFeS₂).
 
 
 
• **Magnetic Separation:**
 
 
• Involves using magnets to separate magnetic materials from non-magnetic gangue.
 
• Example: Beneficiation of magnetite ore (Fe₃O₄).
 
 
 
• **Chemical Leaching:**
 
 
• Uses chemical solutions to dissolve desired elements from the ore while leaving impurities behind.
 
• Example: Cyanide leaching for gold extraction.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Gangue:**

 
 
• Refers to the impurities or non-valuable minerals mixed with the ore.
 
• Examples include silica, clay, and limestone.
 
 
 
• **Ore:**
 
 
• A naturally occurring solid material from which valuable minerals or metals can be extracted economically.
 
• Examples include bauxite (Al₂O₃·2H₂O) for aluminum and galena (PbS) for lead.
 
 
 
• **Application of Enrichment:**
 
 
• Used in industries like metallurgy, mining, and chemical processing.
 
• It is an essential step before smelting and refining processes.
 
 
 
• **Environmental Benefits:**
 
 
• Reduces waste generation and energy consumption during metal extraction.
 
• Helps in sustainable mining practices.
